title: A smoothness criterion for projective conic compactifications of ALF twistor models
exact_target: Compactify ALF twistor spaces and determine Yang–Mills energy quantization for different noncompact asymptotics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002528 (AIM-PHYSICS-0036). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, $L^2$ harmonic forms in geometry and string theory; notes by Anda Degeratu and Mark Haskins, March 2004, 21 March 2004, Etesi questions.

status_qualification: Both twistor and Yang–Mills questions are retained. The source warns that smoothness and irreducibility hypotheses matter for its Chern–Simons quantization statement; they must be checked, not dropped. A projective conic example does not settle arbitrary ALF twistor compactification. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
